notes.title: Updated on March 6th
notes.content:
1. Add offline mode to the game

2. Add guidance on camera movement and rotation

3. Modify the setting of Hongdu Xinfu levels

4. Optimize some sound effects

5. Modify the camera movement mode of the mouse in window mode

6. Modify some issues in the program

notes.title: Update instructions on January 24th
notes.content:
1. Modify the issue of incorrect display related to some buildings

2. Add spacebar pause function

3. Change the "story mode" and "hardcore mode" in the interface to "easy" and "simple"

notes.title: Updated on December 28th
notes.content:
1. Add terrain grid lines when placing buildings

2. Modify some level maps

3. Modify some surface textures

notes.title: Updated instructions on November 3rd
notes.content:
1. Handling some error prompts

2. Modify the sound effects of road construction

3. Add Role configuration file

notes.title: Updated instructions on October 16th
notes.content: Modifying the issue of items being unusable when the status of the warehouse is set to the highest priority

notes.title: Updated instructions on October 14th
notes.content:
1. Optimize some sound effects

2. Modify the configuration file loading method

3. Change some configuration files to modifiable

notes.title: Updated instructions on October 2nd
notes.content: Add two maps: Khotan and Jinyang

notes.title: Updated on July 20th
notes.content:
1. Optimize the display effect of interface fonts

2. Optimize seasonal rendering effects

3. Expand the function of the console command 'enemy' to set parameters for generating enemy forces

4. Add the console command "control enemy", which can control the enemy, but cannot achieve the achievements of the current scene after use

5. Modify some issues that may arise in the program

notes.title: Updated on June 19th
notes.content:
1. Modify the labor allocation function to eliminate the need to consider distance in labor allocation and ensure uniform distribution of all workers.

2. Add the function of setting labor allocation priority

3. Modify some program exceptions.

notes.title: Updated instructions on May 31st
notes.content:
1. Increase the minimum and maximum priority levels in the warehouse

2. Add two levels of difficulty: story and hardcore

3. Default automatic activation of day, night, and season

4. Modify some building models

5. Add entry point prompts for trade caravans

6. When building a building, you can press the R key to modify the direction of the building

7. Reduce the ignition rate of some buildings

8. Annual trade quotas can be set on the trade interface

notes.title: Updated instructions on April 20th
notes.content:
1. Optimize terrain sound effects
2. Correction of incorrect estimated annual production of tea gardens
3. Modify the issue of unmanned transportation when the harvest of farmland is less than 100
4. Add the command "load up" to fill the currently selected warehouse with goods (current scene achievements cannot be obtained after use)
5. An invasion will occur around six months after the construction of an intermediate mansion at the Hongdu New Mansion checkpoint. If no intermediate mansion is built for about 700 years, there will also be an invasion

notes.title: Modifying the rendering effect of graphics
notes.content:
1. Modify the rendering effect of surface vegetation

2. Increase the saturation of colors

3. Modify the bug that the dock will not collapse after burning
